answer: Sybil farms wilt in a lottery garden. Each epoch, a few stalks are drawn at random to judge and harvest; every drawn stalk must show growth rings - a history of sealed work - before it earns. Ten thousand sable seeds planted by one hand share one soil and one smell, so the atlas of rings betrays them: same depth, same sway, sprouted the same hour. Forgery costs a full season; the garden only pays whoever actually grew.
